renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Use ONLY the claims in the ESSENCE list below; every paragraph must correspond to at least one essence item (record indices). Do not add doctrines, comparisons, meta-commentary, or quoted terms. paragraphs.text: Not knowing the truth gets called His freedom — that is just what it is named. And that very not-knowing is the round of rebirth itself, which is terrifying, but only to fools. There is nothing second here.
Mis-knowing named freedom; bondage dreadful-to-fools; nothing second. Read carefully.

paragraphs.text: Call mis-knowing His freedom if you like — that is its name. And that same mis-knowing is bondage itself: dreadful, but only if you are a fool about it. No second thing involved.
Freedom is mis-knowing described. Bondage is that same mis-knowing, scary-to-fools only. Monism, no sequel.
